attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"went missing shortly after arriving at a nearby outland settlement three weeks ago","reason":"Briefing only says the Dispatch is looking for news of him; arrival, settlement and timing are invented."},{"span":"a ferry carrying grain","reason":"Cargo not given in briefing."},{"span":"this morning","reason":"Timing not given."},{"span":"our station in Lowmere","reason":"The Dispatch has no stated station in Lowmere; it stopped sending reporters toward Lowmere."},{"span":"extending any further scouting parties today","reason":"Distorts the briefing fact; scouting parties and 'today' are invented."},{"span":"A recent conflict between The Brine Coast League and Outlanders resulted in six settlements being occupied by the league's forces","reason":"No such conflict exists; the six settlements are simply the League's own count."}],"voice":1,"clarity":2,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The output breaks format by copying the briefing's section headings, has no dry reporter voice, and invents many details, including a war that never happened and a Dispatch station in Lowmere."}
